bundle.title: feat(gp-webapp): show the free election-eve robocall offer
bundle.body:
Stacked on thegoodparty/omni#3275 (gp-api). Until that merges, this PR also shows its commits; the webapp change is the last commit.

The free election-eve robocall offer only matters if eligible candidates see it where they would act on it. Plan tasks are backlog-first, so the offer's task is often not the next one, so it also shows up beside the work the candidate is already doing:

- **Home:** a pale blue card under the next-task card, or above the task list on the legacy Home.
- **Voter Outreach:** a "FREE OFFER" badge on the Robocall tile, and a "Free offer" badge on the election-day purpose.
- **Audience step and voter data page:** a "Free offer" section above the recommendations, in both the robocall audience step and the voter data page.
- **Campaign Plan:** a distinct row for the offer's plan task.

Every surface reads one gp-api answer (`GET /v1/campaigns/mine/robocall-offer`), so no surface can show the offer while another hides it. The webapp never evaluates the flag itself; gp-api does.

Arriving on the offer list prefills the send date to Nov 2 rather than locking it, so the candidate can still move it. The offer list skips "Choose a channel", because it is a robocall and nothing else. A saved offer list is named "Free robocall: …" so the candidate can tell it apart among their lists without another badge. The offer card shows no price, since a cost on a card labelled free reads as a charge.

<!-- CURSOR_SUMMARY -->
---

> [!NOTE]
> **Medium Risk**
> Touches robocall checkout (Stripe promos, authorize binding) and persistent experiment assignment, but eligibility is flag- and env-gated with strict list/code checks.
> 
> **Overview**
> Adds a **free election-eve robocall** program for eligible Nov 2026 general campaigns: gp-api enrolls campaigns, randomizes precincts into treatment/control (persisted in `robocall_experiment_precinct`), exposes a dedicated recommended list variant, and serves **`GET /v1/campaigns/mine/robocall-offer`**. Draft creation can auto-apply a campaign-bound Stripe promo (`ROBOCALL_FREE_OFFER_COUPON_ID`), with re-validation at authorize; offer lists are locked on save. Tracker tasks complete when an offer run is scheduled.
> 
> The webapp surfaces the offer consistently via **`useRobocallFreeOffer`**: Home card, robocall tile/purpose badges, a separate “Free offer” block on voter data and the robocall audience step (no price on the card), styled plan-task rows, and deep links that open robocall compose on the offer list with **Nov 2 prefilled** (editable). Contracts and API client types wire through the new response schema and variant.
> 
> <sup>Reviewed by [Cursor Bugbot](https://cursor.com/bugbot) for commit 1e6e5bfdbfacebb3429904c474d4036b7ee28183. Configure [here](https://www.cursor.com/dashboard/bugbot).</sup>
<!-- /CURSOR_SUMMARY -->

+// One precinct's arm in a precinct-randomized robocall experiment. Keyed on
+// the precinct, not the district: a precinct can sit in several GP districts,
+// and one row makes it treatment or control for every campaign that touches
+// it. Rows are written once and never updated; the readout weights each by
+// 1 / p_treatment. The assigned_for_* columns are provenance only (no foreign
+// keys), so the experiment record outlives a deleted campaign.
+model RobocallExperimentPrecinct {
+  id                     Int      @id @default(autoincrement())
+  createdAt              DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")
+  experimentKey          String   @map("experiment_key")
+  state                  String
+  county                 String
+  precinct               String
+  arm                    String
+  pTreatment             Float    @map("p_treatment")
+  assignedForDistrictId  String   @map("assigned_for_district_id")
+  assignedForCampaignId  Int      @map("assigned_for_campaign_id")
+  landlinesAtAssignment  Int      @map("landlines_at_assignment")
+
+  @@unique([experimentKey, state, county, precinct])
+  @@map("robocall_experiment_precinct")
+}

@@ -0,0 +1,207 @@
+/**
+ * Add the free election-eve robocall offer's plan task to every campaign the
+ * offer applies to. Run once at launch, with the `robocall-free-offer` flag
+ * on and ROBOCALL_FREE_OFFER_COUPON_ID set.
+ *
+ * Only campaigns that already have their default tracker rows get the task:
+ * an early default row would stop materializeStaticTasks from ever building
+ * the rest of the plan. A campaign that already has the task is skipped, so
+ * a second run adds only what the first missed.
+ *
+ * With --execute, each invited campaign is enrolled exactly as its first
+ * Home load would enroll it: its district's precincts are assigned to
+ * treatment and control before the task is written. A dry run assigns
+ * nothing and writes nothing.
+ *
+ * Usage (NOT tsx: esbuild drops emitDecoratorMetadata, so every Nest provider
+ * would be constructed with undefined dependencies):
+ *   node -r @swc-node/register -r tsconfig-paths/register \
+ *     scripts/robocall-free-offer-invites.ts              # dry run
+ *   node -r @swc-node/register -r tsconfig-paths/register \
+ *     scripts/robocall-free-offer-invites.ts --execute
+ *   Add --verbose for Nest's boot log.
+ *
+ * Required env vars: the gp-api set (DATABASE_URL, the people warehouse,
+ * election database, Amplitude and Stripe keys).
+ */
+import '../src/configrc'
+
+import { Module } from '@nestjs/common'
+import { NestFactory } from '@nestjs/core'
+import { FastifyAdapter } from '@nestjs/platform-fastify'
+import { differenceInCalendarWeeks } from 'date-fns'
+import { ROBOCALL_FREE_OFFER_VARIANT } from '@goodparty_org/contracts'
+import { CampaignTaskType, Prisma } from '../src/generated/prisma'
+import { AnalyticsModule } from '../src/analytics/analytics.module'
+import { CampaignsModule } from '../src/campaigns/campaigns.module'
+import { ElectionDbModule } from '../src/electionDb/electionDb.module'
+import { FeaturesModule } from '../src/features/features.module'
+import { loggerModule } from '../src/observability/logging/logger-module'
+import { PrismaModule } from '../src/prisma/prisma.module'
+import { PrismaService } from '../src/prisma/prisma.service'
+import {
+  ROBOCALL_FREE_OFFER_ELECTION_DATE,
+  ROBOCALL_FREE_OFFER_TASK_TITLE,
+} from '../src/robocallFreeOffer/robocallFreeOffer.consts'
+import { RobocallFreeOfferModule } from '../src/robocallFreeOffer/robocallFreeOffer.module'
+import { RobocallFreeOfferService } from '../src/robocallFreeOffer/services/robocallFreeOffer.service'
+import { SharedModule } from '../src/shared/shared.module'
+import { UsersModule } from '../src/users/users.module'
+import { BraintrustModule } from '../src/vendors/braintrust/braintrust.module'
+import { GeminiModule } from '../src/vendors/google/gemini.module'
+
+// Same line as the webapp's Home card (FREE_OFFER_HOME_BODY): the outcome,
+// with the count left to the flow, where it is counted in voters.
+const TASK_DESCRIPTION =
+  'Reach voters the day before Election Day, at no cost to your campaign.'
+
+// The task's button opens the robocall flow on the offer list. trackerTaskId
+// and phase let the run complete the task once it is scheduled.
+export const offerTaskLink = (trackerTaskId: string): string => {
+  const params = new URLSearchParams({
+    compose: 'robocall',
+    recommended: ROBOCALL_FREE_OFFER_VARIANT,
+    source: 'campaign_tracker',
+    trackerTaskId,
+    phase: 'gotv',
+  })
+  return `/dashboard/outreach?${params.toString()}`
+}
+
+// AppModule is deliberately not used: it registers every @Cron job and the
+// SQS consumer, which would start draining the real queue onto whichever
+// machine runs this script. The @Global modules AppModule would provide are
+// listed instead, since the offer's graph reaches providers from each.
+@Module({
+  imports: [
+    loggerModule,
+    PrismaModule,
+    SharedModule,
+    AnalyticsModule,
+    UsersModule,
+    CampaignsModule,
+    ElectionDbModule,
+    FeaturesModule,
+    BraintrustModule,
+    GeminiModule,
+    RobocallFreeOfferModule,
+  ],
+})
+class RobocallFreeOfferInvitesModule {}
+
+const main = async () => {
+  const execute = process.argv.includes('--execute')
+  const verbose = process.argv.includes('--verbose')
+  // An app with an HTTP adapter rather than a bare context: a dev-only vendor
+  // mock controller in the graph registers a body parser on the adapter.
+  // init() wires everything; nothing listens on a port.
+  const app = await NestFactory.create(
+    RobocallFreeOfferInvitesModule,
+    new FastifyAdapter(),
+    { logger: verbose ? ['log', 'error', 'warn', 'debug'] : ['error', 'warn'] },
+  )
+  await app.init()
+
+  try {
+    const prisma = app.get(PrismaService)
+    const offer = app.get(RobocallFreeOfferService)
+    if (!offer.isConfigured()) {
+      throw new Error('ROBOCALL_FREE_OFFER_COUPON_ID is not set')
+    }
+
+    // The cheap rules as a query; the service applies all of them again.
+    const candidates = await prisma.campaign.findMany({
+      where: {
+        isPro: true,
+        organizationSlug: { startsWith: 'campaign-' },
+        details: {
+          path: ['electionDate'],
+          equals: ROBOCALL_FREE_OFFER_ELECTION_DATE,
+        },
+        campaignTrackerTasks: { some: { isDefaultTask: true } },
+        NOT: {
+          campaignTrackerTasks: {
+            some: { title: ROBOCALL_FREE_OFFER_TASK_TITLE },
+          },
+        },
+      },
+      include: { organization: true },
+      orderBy: { id: Prisma.SortOrder.asc },
+    })
+    console.log(
+      `${candidates.length} candidate campaigns` +
+        (execute ? '' : ' (dry run: nothing is assigned or written)'),
+    )
+
+    const invited: number[] = []
+    const failed: number[] = []
+    for (const campaign of candidates) {
+      const { organization } = campaign
+      if (!organization) continue
+      try {
+        const offered = execute
+          ? (await offer.resolveOffer(organization, campaign)) !== null
+          : await offer.wouldOffer(organization, campaign)
+        if (!offered) continue
+        if (execute) await insertTask(prisma, campaign.id)
+        invited.push(campaign.id)
+        console.log(`  campaign ${campaign.id}: invited`)
+      } catch (err) {
+        failed.push(campaign.id)
+        console.error(`  campaign ${campaign.id}: failed`, err)
+      }
+    }
+
+    console.log(
+      `${invited.length} ${execute ? 'invited' : 'would be invited'}, ` +
+        `${failed.length} failed` +
+        (failed.length ? ` (${failed.join(', ')})` : ''),
+    )
+  } finally {
+    await app.close()
+  }
+}
+
+// Dated today and placed in the week of the campaign's own static anchor
+// (its earliest pre-launch row), the way the plan's other rows are weeked.
+// The link needs the row's id, so the row is written and then linked.
+const insertTask = async (
+  prisma: PrismaService,
+  campaignId: number,
+): Promise<void> => {
+  await prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
+    const anchor = await tx.campaignTrackerTask.findFirst({
+      where: { campaignId, isDefaultTask: true, phase: 'preLaunch' },
+      orderBy: { date: Prisma.SortOrder.asc },
+      select: { date: true },
+    })
+    const today = new Date()
+    const row = await tx.campaignTrackerTask.create({
+      data: {
+        campaignId,
+        title: ROBOCALL_FREE_OFFER_TASK_TITLE,
+        description: TASK_DESCRIPTION,
+        cta: 'Send outreach',
+        flowType: CampaignTaskType.robocall,
+        week: anchor
+          ? Math.max(0, differenceInCalendarWeeks(today, anchor.date))
+          : 0,
+        date: today,
+        proRequired: true,
+        isDefaultTask: true,
+        phase: 'gotv',
+      },
+    })
+    await tx.campaignTrackerTask.update({
+      where: { id: row.id },
+      data: { link: offerTaskLink(row.id) },
+    })
+  })
+}
+
+if (require.main === module) {
+  main().catch((err) => {
+    console.error(err)
+    process.exit(1)
+  })
+}

+      campaign,

+    )
+    if (!offer) return NOT_OFFERED
+    return {

+      variant: ROBOCALL_FREE_OFFER_VARIANT,

+      coveredCalls: ROBOCALL_FREE_OFFER_COVERED_CALLS,
+    }
+  }
+}

+// The free election-eve robocall offer for the Nov 3, 2026 general.
+
+// The Amplitude flag. A kill switch only: it is rolled out to everyone and
+// gp-api decides eligibility, because none of Pro, election date or Win ICP
+// reaches Amplitude reliably.
+export const ROBOCALL_FREE_OFFER_FLAG = 'robocall-free-offer'
+
+// Names this experiment's rows in robocall_experiment_precinct and its
+// promotion codes' Stripe metadata.
+export const ROBOCALL_FREE_OFFER_EXPERIMENT_KEY = 'robocall-free-offer-2026-11'
+
+export const ROBOCALL_FREE_OFFER_ELECTION_DATE = '2026-11-03'
+
+// Arms on the campaign's campaign_experiment_assignment row. The campaign is
+// not randomized (its precincts are): `offered` means gp-api found it
+// eligible and assigned its precincts, `withdrawn` that its district came out
+// with no treatment precinct or no treatment landline to call.
+export const ROBOCALL_FREE_OFFER_ARMS = {
+  offered: 'offered',
+  withdrawn: 'withdrawn',
+} as const
+
+export const PRECINCT_ARMS = {
+  treatment: 'treatment',
+  control: 'control',
+} as const
+
+// A district needs this many known precincts for a treatment/control split
+// to mean anything. The Unknown bucket never counts.

+

+// ROBOCALL_FREE_OFFER_COUPON_ID; used only to tell the candidate roughly how
+// many calls the offer covers without a Stripe round-trip.

+

+// (8,844 at 4.5 cents a call).

+  ((ROBOCALL_FREE_OFFER_CAP_CENTS - ROBOCALL_NUMBER_FEE_CENTS) * 10) /
+    PRICE_PER_ROBOCALL_TENTH_CENTS,
+)
+
+export const ROBOCALL_FREE_OFFER_CODE_PREFIX = 'GPOFFER-'
+

+import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest'
+import {
+  assignPrecincts,

+} from './robocallFreeOfferAssignment.util'
+
+// Always draws 0: no shuffle swaps, and the low side of an odd tie-break.
+const lowest = () => 0
+// Always draws the top of the range: the high side of an odd tie-break.
+const highest = (max: number) => max - 1
+
+const treatmentCount = (rows: { arm: string }[]) =>
+  rows.filter((row) => row.arm === 'treatment').length
+
+describe('assignPrecincts', () => {
+  it('splits a fresh even district in half at p = 0.5', () => {
+    const rows = assignPrecincts({
+      totalKnown: 6,
+      existingTreatment: 0,
+      unassigned: ['a', 'b', 'c', 'd', 'e', 'f'],
+      randomInt: lowest,
+    })
+    expect(rows).toHaveLength(6)
+    expect(treatmentCount(rows)).toBe(3)
+    expect(rows.every((row) => row.pTreatment === 0.5)).toBe(true)
+  })
+
+  it('rounds an odd district either way, and still reports p = 0.5', () => {
+    const unassigned = ['a', 'b', 'c', 'd', 'e']
+    const low = assignPrecincts({
+      totalKnown: 5,
+      existingTreatment: 0,
+      unassigned,
+      randomInt: lowest,
+    })
+    const high = assignPrecincts({
+      totalKnown: 5,
+      existingTreatment: 0,
+      unassigned,
+      randomInt: highest,
+    })
+    expect(treatmentCount(low)).toBe(2)
+    expect(treatmentCount(high)).toBe(3)
+    expect(low[0]?.pTreatment).toBe(0.5)
+    expect(high[0]?.pTreatment).toBe(0.5)
+  })
+
+  it('counts treatment an overlapping district already assigned', () => {
+    // 6 known, 2 already treatment and 1 already control: 1 more of the
+    // 3 left is treatment, so each has a 1 in 3 chance.
+    const rows = assignPrecincts({
+      totalKnown: 6,
+      existingTreatment: 2,
+      unassigned: ['d', 'e', 'f'],
+      randomInt: lowest,
+    })
+    expect(treatmentCount(rows)).toBe(1)
+    expect(rows[0]?.pTreatment).toBeCloseTo(1 / 3)
+  })
+
+  it('assigns no treatment when the district is already past half', () => {
+    const rows = assignPrecincts({
+      totalKnown: 4,
+      existingTreatment: 3,
+      unassigned: ['d'],
+      randomInt: lowest,
+    })
+    expect(rows).toEqual([{ key: 'd', arm: 'control', pTreatment: 0 }])
+  })
+
+  it('returns nothing when every precinct is already assigned', () => {
+    expect(

+        totalKnown: 4,
+        existingTreatment: 2,
+        unassigned: [],
+        randomInt: lowest,
+      }),
+    ).toEqual([])
+  })
+
+  it('keeps every key exactly once', () => {
+    const unassigned = ['a', 'b', 'c', 'd', 'e', 'f', 'g']
+    const rows = assignPrecincts({
+      totalKnown: 7,
+      existingTreatment: 0,
+      unassigned,
+      randomInt: highest,
+    })
+    expect(rows.map((row) => row.key).sort()).toEqual(unassigned)
+  })
+})

+describe('isAfterOfferElection', () => {
+  it('keeps the offer through Election Day, Eastern time', () => {

+    // 11:30pm Nov 3 in New York is already Nov 4 in UTC.

+import { formatInTimeZone } from 'date-fns-tz'
+import {
+  PRECINCT_ARMS,
+  ROBOCALL_FREE_OFFER_ELECTION_DATE,
+} from './robocallFreeOffer.consts'
+
+export type PrecinctArm = (typeof PRECINCT_ARMS)[keyof typeof PRECINCT_ARMS]
+
+export type NewPrecinctAssignment<Key> = {
+  key: Key
+  arm: PrecinctArm
+  pTreatment: number
+}
+
+// Returns an integer in [0, max). Injected so tests can fix the draw.
+export type RandomInt = (max: number) => number
+
+// Draws without replacement, which is a uniform shuffle.
+const shuffle = <T>(items: readonly T[], randomInt: RandomInt): T[] => {
+  const pool = [...items]
+  const out: T[] = []
+  while (pool.length > 0) {
+    out.push(...pool.splice(randomInt(pool.length), 1))
+  }
+  return out
+}
+
+const clamp = (value: number, max: number): number =>
+  Math.max(0, Math.min(value, max))
+
+// Splits a district's not-yet-assigned precincts so the district as a whole
+// ends with round(N/2) treatment precincts, counting the ones an overlapping
+// district already made treatment. An odd N goes up or down at random.
+//
+// pTreatment is each new row's marginal chance of treatment, averaged over
+// the tie-break, so it is 0.5 in a fresh district and drifts from it only
+// when earlier assignments left the district unbalanced. The readout weights
+// by 1 / p, so it has to be the real probability, not the realized share.
+export const assignPrecincts = <Key>(params: {
+  totalKnown: number
+  existingTreatment: number
+  unassigned: readonly Key[]
+  randomInt: RandomInt
+}): NewPrecinctAssignment<Key>[] => {
+  const { totalKnown, existingTreatment, unassigned, randomInt } = params
+  if (unassigned.length === 0) return []
+
+  const needLow = clamp(
+    Math.floor(totalKnown / 2) - existingTreatment,
+    unassigned.length,
+  )
+  const needHigh = clamp(
+    Math.ceil(totalKnown / 2) - existingTreatment,
+    unassigned.length,
+  )
+  const need = randomInt(2) === 0 ? needLow : needHigh
+  const pTreatment = (needLow + needHigh) / 2 / unassigned.length
+
+  return shuffle(unassigned, randomInt).map((key, index) => ({
+    key,
+    arm: index < need ? PRECINCT_ARMS.treatment : PRECINCT_ARMS.control,
+    pTreatment,
+  }))
+}
+
+// The offer ends once Election Day is over, on Eastern time. Injected `now`
+// so tests can fix the clock.
+export const isAfterOfferElection = (now: Date): boolean =>
+  formatInTimeZone(now, 'America/New_York', 'yyyy-MM-dd') >
+  ROBOCALL_FREE_OFFER_ELECTION_DATE

+import { BadRequestException, Injectable } from '@nestjs/common'
+import { randomInt } from 'node:crypto'
+import type Stripe from 'stripe'
+import { z } from 'zod'
+import {
+  encodePrecinctPair,
+  ROBOCALL_FREE_OFFER_VARIANT,
+} from '@goodparty_org/contracts'
+import { createPrismaBase, MODELS } from 'src/prisma/util/prisma.util'
+import { getEnv } from 'src/shared/util/env.util'
+import { ContactsService } from '@/contacts/services/contacts.service'
+import { ElectionsService } from '@/elections/services/elections.service'
+import { CampaignExperimentAssignmentService } from '@/features/services/campaignExperimentAssignment.service'
+import { FeaturesService } from '@/features/services/features.service'
+import { UNSENT_OUTREACH_STATUSES } from '@/outreach/util/unsentOutreachStatuses.util'
+import type { PrecinctLandlines } from '@/peopleDb/databricks/databricksVoter.service'
+import type { DbxDistrict } from '@/peopleDb/databricks/databricksVoterSql.util'
+import { VoterRecommendedListsService } from '@/peopleDb/services/voterRecommendedLists.service'
+import { findEquivalentFilter } from '@/recommendedLists/recommendedListsDedupe.util'
+import { StripeService } from '@/vendors/stripe/services/stripe.service'
+import { Campaign, Organization, OutreachType } from '../../generated/prisma'
+import {
+  MIN_KNOWN_PRECINCTS,
+  PRECINCT_ARMS,
+  ROBOCALL_FREE_OFFER_ADVISORY_LOCK_KEY,
+  ROBOCALL_FREE_OFFER_ARMS,
+  ROBOCALL_FREE_OFFER_CODE_PREFIX,
+  ROBOCALL_FREE_OFFER_ELECTION_DATE,
+  ROBOCALL_FREE_OFFER_EXPERIMENT_KEY,
+  ROBOCALL_FREE_OFFER_FLAG,
+} from '../robocallFreeOffer.consts'
+import {
+  assignPrecincts,
+  isAfterOfferElection,
+} from '../robocallFreeOfferAssignment.util'
+
+// Campaign.details is Prisma JSON; `.catch(null)` keeps one off-shape key
+// elsewhere in details from hiding a good election date.
+const CampaignElectionSchema = z.object({
+  electionDate: z.string().nullable().optional().catch(null),
+})
+
+const SMS_OUTREACH_TYPES = [OutreachType.text, OutreachType.p2p]
+
+const INTERNAL_EMAIL_DOMAIN = '@goodparty.org'
+
+// Uppercase letters and digits without the ones that read alike (0/O, 1/I).
+const CODE_ALPHABET = 'ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZ23456789'
+const CODE_LENGTH = 8
+
+type DistrictPrecincts = {
+  district: DbxDistrict
+  known: PrecinctLandlines[]
+}
+
+const precinctKey = (county: string, precinct: string): string =>
+  encodePrecinctPair(county, precinct)
+
+// Decides who gets the free election-eve robocall, assigns precincts to
+// treatment and control, and hands out the campaign's promotion code. The
+// offer resolves to the campaign's treatment precincts (as the `county|
+// precinct` pairs a saved list stores) or to null, and every surface and the
+// payment path read that one answer.
+@Injectable()
+export class RobocallFreeOfferService extends createPrismaBase(
+  MODELS.RobocallExperimentPrecinct,
+) {
+  private readonly couponId = getEnv('ROBOCALL_FREE_OFFER_COUPON_ID') || null
+
+  constructor(
+    private readonly features: FeaturesService,
+    private readonly experimentAssignments: CampaignExperimentAssignmentService,
+    private readonly contacts: ContactsService,
+    private readonly reads: VoterRecommendedListsService,
+    private readonly elections: ElectionsService,
+    private readonly stripe: StripeService,
+  ) {
+    super()
+  }
+
+  // Unset (as in prod until the live coupon exists) hides the offer
+  // everywhere: there would be no code to hand out.
+  isConfigured(): boolean {
+    return this.couponId !== null
+  }
+
+  // What the surfaces ask: the offer list's precincts, or null when the offer
+  // does not apply. The first call for an eligible campaign assigns its
+  // district's precincts and enrolls it. The flag only gates here, so turning
+  // it off hides the offer and stops new assignment but never voids a code a
+  // draft already holds.
+  async resolveOffer(
+    organization: Organization,
+    campaign: Campaign,
+  ): Promise<string[] | null> {
+    return this.resolve(organization, campaign, true)
+  }
+
+  // The same answer without assigning or enrolling anything, for a dry run.
+  // A campaign that would be enrolled counts as offered, though its random
+  // half could still come out with no landline to call.
+  async wouldOffer(
+    organization: Organization,
+    campaign: Campaign,
+  ): Promise<boolean> {
+    return (await this.resolve(organization, campaign, false)) !== null
+  }
+
+  private async resolve(
+    organization: Organization,
+    campaign: Campaign,
+    assign: boolean,
+  ): Promise<string[] | null> {
+    if (!this.isConfigured()) return null
+    const internal = await this.hasInternalOwner(campaign)
+    if (!this.passesCampaignRules(organization, campaign, internal)) return null
+
+    const arm = await this.experimentAssignments.findArm(
+      campaign.id,
+      ROBOCALL_FREE_OFFER_FLAG,
+    )
+    if (arm === ROBOCALL_FREE_OFFER_ARMS.withdrawn) return null
+
+    if (!internal) {
+      const flagOn = await this.features.isFeatureEnabled({
+        user: campaign.userId,
+        feature: ROBOCALL_FREE_OFFER_FLAG,
+      })
+      if (!flagOn) return null
+    }
+    if (!(await this.passesOutreachRules(organization, campaign, internal)))
+      return null
+    // Win ICP is a slow rule the stored arm caches, but it is checked ahead
+    // of the warehouse read below so a non-ICP campaign never pays for one.
+    if (arm === null && !internal && !(await this.isWinIcp(organization)))
+      return null
+
+    const precincts = await this.districtPrecincts(organization)
+    if (!precincts) return null
+
+    if (arm === ROBOCALL_FREE_OFFER_ARMS.offered) {
+      return this.treatmentPairs(precincts)
+    }
+    if (!assign) {
+      return precincts.known.length >= MIN_KNOWN_PRECINCTS ? [] : null
+    }
+    return this.enroll(campaign, precincts)
+  }
+
+  // What the payment path asks: the same answer for an already-enrolled
+  // campaign, with the rules that can change since enrollment rechecked and
+  // no flag. `excludeOutreachId` is the draft being paid for, so the
+  // candidate's own offer run does not count as a robocall already booked.
+  async enrolledTreatmentPrecincts(
+    organization: Organization,
+    campaign: Campaign,
+    excludeOutreachId?: number,
+  ): Promise<string[] | null> {
+    const internal = await this.hasInternalOwner(campaign)
+    if (!this.passesCampaignRules(organization, campaign, internal)) return null
+    const arm = await this.experimentAssignments.findArm(
+      campaign.id,
+      ROBOCALL_FREE_OFFER_FLAG,
+    )
+    if (arm !== ROBOCALL_FREE_OFFER_ARMS.offered) return null
+    if (
+      !(await this.passesOutreachRules(
+        organization,
+        campaign,
+        internal,
+        excludeOutreachId,
+      ))
+    ) {
+      return null
+    }
+    const precincts = await this.districtPrecincts(organization)
+    return precincts ? this.treatmentPairs(precincts) : null
+  }
+
+  isOfferPromotionCode(promo: Stripe.PromotionCode): boolean {
+    return promo.metadata?.experiment === ROBOCALL_FREE_OFFER_EXPERIMENT_KEY
+  }
+
+  // The code is shown on the pay step, so this is what stops it being typed
+  // onto another campaign's robocall or onto a list other than the offer's.
+  async assertOfferBinding(params: {
+    promo: Stripe.PromotionCode
+    organization: Organization
+    campaign: Campaign
+    outreachId: number
+    voterFileFilterId: number | null
+  }): Promise<void> {
+    const { promo, organization, campaign, outreachId, voterFileFilterId } =
+      params
+    const refuse = () =>
+      new BadRequestException(
+        'This free offer code only works on your free offer robocall list',
+      )
+    if (promo.metadata?.campaignId !== String(campaign.id)) throw refuse()
+    if (voterFileFilterId === null) throw refuse()
+    const precincts = await this.enrolledTreatmentPrecincts(
+      organization,
+      campaign,
+      outreachId,
+    )
+    if (!precincts) throw refuse()
+    if (!(await this.isOfferList(organization, voterFileFilterId, precincts))) {
+      throw refuse()
+    }
+  }
+
+  // The code to apply to a fresh robocall draft, or null when the draft is
+  // not the campaign's offer run. Reuses the code from an earlier offer draft
+  // while it is still live in Stripe, else mints one.
+  async codeForDraft(params: {
+    organization: Organization
+    campaign: Campaign
+    outreachId: number
+    voterFileFilterId: number
+  }): Promise<string | null> {
+    const { organization, campaign, outreachId, voterFileFilterId } = params
+    if (!this.couponId) return null
+    const precincts = await this.enrolledTreatmentPrecincts(
+      organization,
+      campaign,
+      outreachId,
+    )
+    if (!precincts) return null
+    if (!(await this.isOfferList(organization, voterFileFilterId, precincts))) {
+      return null
+    }
+
+    const earlier = await this.client.outreachRobocall.findFirst({
+      where: {
+        promoCode: { startsWith: ROBOCALL_FREE_OFFER_CODE_PREFIX },
+        outreach: { campaignId: campaign.id },
+      },
+      orderBy: { outreachId: 'desc' },
+      select: { promoCode: true },
+    })
+    if (earlier?.promoCode) {
+      const live = await this.stripe.findActivePromotionCode(earlier.promoCode)
+      if (live) return live.code
+    }
+
+    const created = await this.stripe.createPromotionCode({
+      couponId: this.couponId,
+      code: this.newCode(),
+      metadata: {
+        experiment: ROBOCALL_FREE_OFFER_EXPERIMENT_KEY,
+        campaignId: String(campaign.id),
+      },
+    })
+    return created.code
+  }
+
+  // "THE list": saved from the offer card, untouched, and holding exactly
+  // the campaign's treatment precincts. Robocall re-resolves the list at
+  // authorize and at staging, and the list is locked on save, so this is
+  // what the code is bound to.
+  async isOfferList(
+    organization: Organization,
+    voterFileFilterId: number,
+    treatmentPrecincts: string[],
+  ): Promise<boolean> {
+    const list = await this.client.voterFileFilter.findFirst({
+      where: { id: voterFileFilterId, organizationSlug: organization.slug },
+      include: { activityConditions: true },
+    })
+    if (!list) return false
+    if (
+      list.recommendedVariant !== ROBOCALL_FREE_OFFER_VARIANT ||
+      list.recommendedModified !== false ||
+      list.hasLandline !== true ||
+      list.geoPoly !== null ||
+      list.sampleSize !== null
+    ) {
+      return false
+    }
+    const expected = offerListFilter(treatmentPrecincts)
+    return findEquivalentFilter(list, [{ ...expected, id: list.id }]) !== null
+  }
+
+  // A goodparty.org owner skips the eligibility rules (Pro, election date,
+  // sent texts, other robocalls booked, demo / test mode, Win ICP and the
+  // flag), so staff can run the offer end to end on any of their Win
+  // campaigns, in a preview or in prod. What the offer itself needs still
+  // applies: Win, before Election Day, the offer used once, and enough
+  // precincts to split. The readout leaves these campaigns out.
+  private async hasInternalOwner(campaign: Campaign): Promise<boolean> {
+    const owner = await this.client.user.findUnique({
+      where: { id: campaign.userId },
+      select: { email: true },
+    })
+    return owner?.email.toLowerCase().endsWith(INTERNAL_EMAIL_DOMAIN) ?? false
+  }
+
+  // Rules read straight off the campaign and organization rows.
+  private passesCampaignRules(
+    organization: Organization,
+    campaign: Campaign,
+    internal: boolean,
+  ): boolean {
+    // A used offer ends with the booked-robocall rule; an unused one ends
+    // after Election Day, so its saved list goes back to being a plain list.
+    if (isAfterOfferElection(new Date())) return false
+    // Win only: there is no product column, and `eo-` is Serve.
+    if (!organization.slug.startsWith('campaign-')) return false
+    if (internal) return true
+    if (!campaign.isPro) return false
+    const parsed = CampaignElectionSchema.safeParse(campaign.details)
+    const electionDate = parsed.success ? parsed.data.electionDate : null
+    return electionDate === ROBOCALL_FREE_OFFER_ELECTION_DATE
+  }
+
+  // Rules that need other tables: has booked no robocall, has sent texts,
+  // and is not a demo or test-mode campaign. For a goodparty.org owner only
+  // a booked offer run counts as a robocall, and the other two are skipped.
+  private async passesOutreachRules(
+    organization: Organization,
+    campaign: Campaign,
+    internal: boolean,
+    excludeOutreachId?: number,
+  ): Promise<boolean> {
+    const bookedRobocall = await this.client.outreach.count({
+      where: {
+        campaignId: campaign.id,
+        outreachType: OutreachType.robocall,
+        status: { notIn: UNSENT_OUTREACH_STATUSES },
+        ...(excludeOutreachId === undefined
+          ? {}
+          : { id: { not: excludeOutreachId } }),
+        ...(internal
+          ? {
+              robocall: {
+                promoCode: { startsWith: ROBOCALL_FREE_OFFER_CODE_PREFIX },
+              },
+            }
+          : {}),
+      },
+    })
+    if (bookedRobocall > 0) return false
+    if (internal) return true
+    if (campaign.isDemo || organization.testModeCreatedAt !== null) return false
+    const sentSms = await this.client.outreach.count({
+      where: {
+        campaignId: campaign.id,
+        outreachType: { in: SMS_OUTREACH_TYPES },
+        status: { notIn: UNSENT_OUTREACH_STATUSES },
+      },
+    })
+    return sentSms > 0
+  }
+
+  // The district's known precincts (the Unknown bucket dropped) with their
+  // landline counts. Null when the campaign has no voter district at all, or
+  // one too large for a saved list to hold the treatment half.
+  private async districtPrecincts(
+    organization: Organization,
+  ): Promise<DistrictPrecincts | null> {
+    let eligible: Awaited<
+      ReturnType<ContactsService['resolveEligibleDistrict']>
+    >
+    try {
+      eligible = await this.contacts.resolveEligibleDistrict(organization)
+    } catch (err) {
+      // No district or no voter data is an ordinary "not offered", not an
+      // outage; anything else is.
+      if (!(err instanceof BadRequestException)) throw err
+      this.logger.info(
+        { err, organizationSlug: organization.slug },
+        'robocall free offer: no voter district, not offered',
+      )
+      return null
+    }
+    const district = await this.reads.resolveDistrict(
+      eligible.districtId,
+      eligible.dataset,
+    )
+    const { precincts, truncated } =
+      await this.reads.precinctLandlines(district)
+    if (truncated) return null
+    return {
+      district,
+      known: precincts.filter(({ precinct }) => precinct !== ''),
+    }
+  }
+
+  private async assignmentsFor({
+    district,
+    known,
+  }: DistrictPrecincts): Promise<Map<string, string>> {
+    const counties = [...new Set(known.map(({ county }) => county))]
+    const rows = await this.model.findMany({
+      where: {
+        experimentKey: ROBOCALL_FREE_OFFER_EXPERIMENT_KEY,
+        state: district.state,
+        county: { in: counties },
+      },
+      select: { county: true, precinct: true, arm: true },
+    })
+    return new Map(
+      rows.map((row) => [precinctKey(row.county, row.precinct), row.arm]),
+    )
+  }
+
+  // Null, not [], when none of the district's current precincts is
+  // treatment (the warehouse's precinct names can drift after enrollment):
+  // an empty precinct filter would be every landline in the district, the
+  // control half included, so such a campaign simply stays control.
+  private async treatmentPairs(
+    precincts: DistrictPrecincts,
+  ): Promise<string[] | null> {
+    const arms = await this.assignmentsFor(precincts)
+    const treatment = precincts.known
+      .map(({ county, precinct }) => precinctKey(county, precinct))
+      .filter((key) => arms.get(key) === PRECINCT_ARMS.treatment)
+    return treatment.length > 0 ? treatment : null
+  }
+
+  // Runs once per campaign, after the slow rules passed; the stored arm
+  // caches them. Precincts are assigned under one experiment-wide lock
+  // because overlapping districts share them, and inserts that lose a race
+  // are dropped and re-read rather than overwritten.
+  private async enroll(
+    campaign: Campaign,
+    precincts: DistrictPrecincts,
+  ): Promise<string[] | null> {
+    if (precincts.known.length < MIN_KNOWN_PRECINCTS) return null
+
+    const { district, known } = precincts
+    await this.client.$transaction(async (tx) => {
+      await tx.$executeRaw`SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(${ROBOCALL_FREE_OFFER_ADVISORY_LOCK_KEY}::integer, 0)`
+      const counties = [...new Set(known.map(({ county }) => county))]
+      const existing = await tx.robocallExperimentPrecinct.findMany({
+        where: {
+          experimentKey: ROBOCALL_FREE_OFFER_EXPERIMENT_KEY,
+          state: district.state,
+          county: { in: counties },
+        },
+        select: { county: true, precinct: true, arm: true },
+      })
+      const arms = new Map(
+        existing.map((row) => [precinctKey(row.county, row.precinct), row.arm]),
+      )
+      const unassigned = known.filter(
+        ({ county, precinct }) => !arms.has(precinctKey(county, precinct)),
+      )
+      const existingTreatment = known.filter(
+        ({ county, precinct }) =>
+          arms.get(precinctKey(county, precinct)) === PRECINCT_ARMS.treatment,
+      ).length
+      const assigned = assignPrecincts({
+        totalKnown: known.length,
+        existingTreatment,
+        unassigned,
+        randomInt: (max) => randomInt(max),
+      })
+      if (assigned.length === 0) return
+      await tx.robocallExperimentPrecinct.createMany({
+        data: assigned.map(({ key, arm, pTreatment }) => ({
+          experimentKey: ROBOCALL_FREE_OFFER_EXPERIMENT_KEY,
+          state: district.state,
+          county: key.county,
+          precinct: key.precinct,
+          arm,
+          pTreatment,
+          assignedForDistrictId: district.districtId,
+          assignedForCampaignId: campaign.id,
+          landlinesAtAssignment: key.landlines,
+        })),
+        skipDuplicates: true,
+      })
+    })
+
+    const arms = await this.assignmentsFor(precincts)
+    const treatment = known.filter(
+      ({ county, precinct }) =>
+        arms.get(precinctKey(county, precinct)) === PRECINCT_ARMS.treatment,
+    )
+    const offered =
+      treatment.length > 0 && treatment.some(({ landlines }) => landlines > 0)
+    const arm = await this.experimentAssignments.recordArm({
+      campaign,
+      flagKey: ROBOCALL_FREE_OFFER_FLAG,
+      arm: offered
+        ? ROBOCALL_FREE_OFFER_ARMS.offered
+        : ROBOCALL_FREE_OFFER_ARMS.withdrawn,
+    })
+    if (arm !== ROBOCALL_FREE_OFFER_ARMS.offered) return null
+    return treatment.map(({ county, precinct }) =>
+      precinctKey(county, precinct),
+    )
+  }
+
+  private async isWinIcp(organization: Organization): Promise<boolean> {
+    if (!organization.positionId) return false
+    const position = await this.elections.getPositionById(
+      organization.positionId,
+    )
+    return position?.isWinIcp === true
+  }
+
+  private newCode(): string {
+    let suffix = ''
+    for (let i = 0; i < CODE_LENGTH; i++) {
+      suffix += CODE_ALPHABET[randomInt(CODE_ALPHABET.length)]
+    }
+    return `${ROBOCALL_FREE_OFFER_CODE_PREFIX}${suffix}`
+  }
+}
+
+// The offer list's saved shape: every landline voter in the treatment
+// precincts who has not already voted. The same "Voted in election: Unknown"
+// screen as every other non-event recommendation, so a banked vote is not
+// called.
+export const offerListFilter = (treatmentPrecincts: string[]) => ({
+  hasLandline: true,
+  votedStatus: ['unknown'],
+  precincts: treatmentPrecincts,
+})

+import { useQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query'
+import type { RobocallFreeOfferResponse } from '@goodparty_org/contracts'
+import { clientRequest } from 'gpApi/typed-request'
+import { useOrganization } from '@shared/organization-picker'

+export const ROBOCALL_FREE_OFFER_QUERY_KEY = 'robocall-free-offer'
+
+// The free election-eve robocall offer, as gp-api decides it for this
+// campaign: every surface that shows the offer reads this one answer, so a
+// campaign never sees it in one place and not another. gp-api checks the
+// flag and eligibility; the webapp only renders. Loading and errors read as
+// "no offer", so nothing renders until gp-api has said yes.
+export const useRobocallFreeOffer = (): {
+  offer: RobocallFreeOfferResponse | null

+  const orgSlug = useOrganization()?.slug
+
+  const query = useQuery({
+    queryKey: [ROBOCALL_FREE_OFFER_QUERY_KEY, orgSlug],
+    queryFn: async () => {
+      const { data } = await clientRequest(
+        'GET /v1/campaigns/mine/robocall-offer',
+        {},
+      )
+      return data
+    },
+    enabled: !!orgSlug,
+    refetchOnWindowFocus: false,
+  })
+
+  return { offer: query.data?.eligible ? query.data : null }
+}

findings.body:
**A user can make themselves an "internal owner" by changing their own email.**

`hasInternalOwner` skips the offer's eligibility rules (Pro, election date, sent texts, other robocalls booked, demo/test mode, Win ICP and the flag). The only test is whether the owner's stored email ends in `@goodparty.org`.

Users can write that email themselves:
- `PUT /v1/users/me` (`users.controller.ts` `updateMe`) binds `UpdateUserInputSchema`, which is `CreateUserInputSchema.omit({ password, roles }).partial()`. `email` is still an allowed field.
- The controller passes the body straight to `usersService.updateUser`, which writes it with no check that the user owns the new address.
- `WriteEmailSchema` only lowercases and trims the value.

So any signed-in Win user can send `{"email":"x@goodparty.org"}` and get the free robocall, which is a real Stripe promo cost. The comment above this method says the bypass also applies in prod.

Fix: base the bypass on something a user can't assign to themselves, such as an admin/staff role or an allowlist of staff user IDs. Making `email` non-writable on `PUT /v1/users/me` would also close this path.

Falsification check: this finding is wrong if `updateMe` or `updateUser` strips or rejects `email`, or if the bypass is gated by environment. I checked `users.controller.ts:82-86`, `schemas/UpdateUserInput.schema.ts` and `shared/schemas/Email.schema.ts`, and none of them does.

output.summary:
This PR adds the free election-eve robocall offer. In gp-api it enrolls eligible campaigns, splits their precincts into treatment and control (`robocall_experiment_precinct`), adds an offer list variant and `GET /v1/campaigns/mine/robocall-offer`, and auto-applies a campaign-bound Stripe promo that is checked again at authorize. In the webapp it shows the offer on Home, Voter Outreach, the audience step, voter data and Campaign Plan. That matches the description, including the commits from the stacked #3275.

The scout flagged six areas, and five came back clean:
- **Promo:** a campaign can't redeem it twice or keep it after switching lists. A partial unique index backs this, and the same binding check runs at apply and at authorize.
- **Precinct assignment:** it holds up under concurrent requests, using an advisory lock and `skipDuplicates`. The migration matches the Prisma model.
- **Databricks filter:** precinct values are bound as parameters, and an empty precinct set can't widen the audience.
- **Invite script and env:** the script defaults to a dry run, and the coupon env var is optional.
- **Webapp:** every surface reads the same hook, which shows nothing while loading or on error. The endpoint path matches the gp-api route. The Nov 2 date is set only when the flow opens, so it doesn't overwrite a date the candidate picks.

The sixth area holds the one blocker, posted inline: the `@goodparty.org` owner bypass.

A human should check by hand what this review did not: the step order and back button after "Choose a channel" is skipped on the offer list, the offer wording against the product-copy and Win/Serve vocabulary rules, the Stripe coupon IDs for each environment in `deploy/index.ts`, and the migration against real data.
